prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a rear-end collision. The patient had 4 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1368; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented four times following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of right shoulder pain, reduced range of motion, and pain radiating into the upper arm. On initial evaluation, there was tenderness over the anterior shoulder and restricted active abduction and external rotation. Neurovascular examination of the right upper extremity was intact. Imaging was obtained to rule out fracture, and no acute bony abnormality was identified. The working impression was soft tissue injury to the right shoulder, including strain of the rotator cuff musculature.

Treatment consisted of a structured physical therapy program focusing on gentle range-of-motion exercises, progressive strengthening of the scapular stabilizers and rotator cuff, and postural education. Anti-inflammatory medication was prescribed for pain control, and ice and activity modification were recommended. At follow-up visits, the patient reported gradual improvement in pain intensity and sleep quality, with increasing functional use of the arm for daily activities. Range of motion improved, though mild limitation in overhead reach persisted at the most recent visit. Prognosis is good with continued home exercise and graded return to activity. Further follow-up will be arranged if symptoms worsen.
